text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Great job, everyone~!
Another year of the Triple Tiara route is over, huh.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Harp Alpha was great,
and Yukino Bijin was amazing too!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text: "Fewer cheers than the Oaks makes it feel a bit lonely, though. I mean, it was amazing back then too."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"So this is what it feels like when a fad dies down, huh...
...Let's get going."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
So in the end, you're gonna find out too?
About those feelings...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Mmm...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: —No.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I got results.
I ran through to the end, but...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't...
a "sparkling run"...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"My head was spinning in circles,
and I couldn't run like I did in the Queen Stakes."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(I know they're just cheerin' me on normally.
And yet...)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I ain't the same
as I was before.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't... just about winning
for me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to become a "City Girl"
that everyone would genuinely want to cheer for... but.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
The one everyone truly wanted to cheer for
was me without the "City Girl" persona.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If only I didn't care about winning...
If only I stayed just a simple country bumpkin, an airy
"Snow Angel"――

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Did they ever tell me
that they still liked me, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...'Scuse me for whining like that.
Um... I've gotta set my next goal.
choice_data_list: It's perfectly fine to take it slow.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But...
choice_data_list: Shall we have something delicious tonight?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...'Scuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There are plenty of ways to speak to a hurt Yukino Bijin as an adult.
However, what she truly needs right now is...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah!
Did Mifuyu-chan already leave!?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm glad we got to talk properly. Mifuyu-chan always gives me confidence, y'know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Yukino Bijin has a wonderful best friend
with whom she can elevate herself and
build mutual confidence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Reaching her heart should help her far more
than a hundred spoken words ever could—
